def masks_bands(a):
    bg=a[0,0]; rows=np.where((a!=bg).any(axis=1))[0]
    bands=[]; grp=[rows[0]]; prev=rows[0]
    for r in rows[1:]:
        if r>prev+1: bands.append(grp); grp=[r]
        else: grp.append(r)
        prev=r
    bands.append(grp)
    return bg,[(grp[0],grp[-1],a[grp[0]:grp[-1]+1]!=bg) for grp in bands]

def transform2(g):
    a=np.array(g); out=[row[:] for row in g]
    bg,bands=masks_bands(a)
    if len(bands)!=2: return out
    (r1a,r1b,M1),(r2a,r2b,M2)=bands
    w1=int(np.where(M1.any(axis=0))[0].max()); w2=int(np.where(M2.any(axis=0))[0].max())
    narrow,wide,ra,w = (M1,M2,r1a,w2) if w1<w2 else (M2,M1,r2a,w1)
    H,W=narrow.shape
    for r in range(H):
        cols=np.where(narrow[r])[0]
        if len(cols)<2: continue
        p,q=cols[-2],cols[-1]; d=q-p
        if d<=0: continue
        c=q+d
        while c<=w:
            if out[ra+r][c]==bg: out[ra+r][c]=1
            c+=d
    return out
